answer: Require every identity to carry a quill-signed chain of completed-work receipts: each paid task ends with the counterparty signing a receipt, and an identity earns voting weight only from receipts it actually holds. Receipts form a quartz-clear audit trail any peer can verify, while karst-like porous clusters of identities sharing one receipt chain are flagged as a single operator. Forging ten thousand fakes then means doing ten thousand real jobs, so a Sybil farm pays full price per copy and honest agents keep their earned standing.
